text.p: The following are the leading stories in the Maltese press on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Government to retain Tour Operator Support Scheme for tourists. Scheme helps tour operators make holidays in Malta more competitive in view of strong exchange rate of Maltese lira.
- Opposition Nationalist Party raises Lm7,500 (about $20,000) in first fund-raising event for television station. Party wants to raise Lm500,000 to open its own station.
- Malta opposes military role for Organisation for Security and Cooperation in Europe. Prime Minister Sant suggests OSCE link with United Nations Security Council.
- Beauty contest organisers aim for Malta to take part in Miss World competition from which country withdrew some years ago after local organisers failed to pay fee.
- Ecstasy drug is growing threat to young.
